topic: Paying minimum vs full credit card balance (Oscar vs Petra)

scenes.narration: Paying only the minimum on a five thousand dollar card stretches the bill out to twenty seven years. I am Doctor Dollar. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar holding a clipboard with a credit card statement marked MINIMUM PAYMENT, comic burst banner reads TWENTY SEVEN YEARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Oscar and Petra each charged five thousand dollars on a credit card with twenty four percent interest after a home repair.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, left side man oscar with a card statement reading FIVE THOUSAND, right side woman petra with the same statement, both at home, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Oscar pays only the minimum payment of one hundred dollars each month, telling himself it is fine because it does not feel painful.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man oscar on a couch swiping a card while a statement reading MINIMUM ONE HUNDRED appears, comic banner reads PAINLESS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Petra cuts her grocery and entertainment spending and pays the full five thousand dollar balance off in eight months.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman petra at a kitchen table writing aggressive payments labeled FIVE HUNDRED A MONTH, a small grocery list cut down, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Twenty seven years later Oscar will have paid the bank over fifteen thousand dollars in interest on his original five thousand dollar charge.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked older man oscar at a kitchen table holding a final statement, comic banner reads FIFTEEN THOUSAND IN INTEREST, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Petra paid less than four hundred dollars in total interest and had a clean card eight months later. Same charge, very different prognosis.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split scene, left side oscar with a long timeline of payments, right side petra with a clean card statement and a smile, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Always pay the full statement balance on credit cards. Minimum payments are how the bank gets rich. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
